reason: Adds a Command Code LLM provider route to DeepSeek Harness, including external API requests, streaming text and tool calls, and browser-assisted API-key setup.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Command Code 大语言模型提供商，支持通过其 API 进行流式文本生成和工具调用。
summaries.en: Adds a Command Code large-language-model provider to DeepSeek Harness with streaming text generation and tool-call support through the provider API.

capabilities: Sends text and tool-call requests to Command Code's /alpha/generate API
Supports streaming responses, cancellation, retries, usage reporting, and reasoning deltas
Retrieves and stores a Command Code API key through a browser-assisted OAuth flow and DSH credentials service
Runs a temporary localhost callback server for OAuth completion
